data.synopsis:
Gakken's hugely popular illustrated encyclopedia series, which everyone can enjoy with its laid-back four-panel comics, is finally being adapted into a TV anime!

Discover surprising aspects and fun facts about living creatures—full of secrets that will make you say, "Wow!"

Enjoy this new kind of anime that makes even scary things fun and easy to watch, with its cute art style.

(Source: Official Site, translated)

data.synopsis:
Yuu-hachi's Dekai Hachi; Miseban no Spis; and Aa, Tanuki wa Mou Dame desu manga all adapted into an omnibus short anime.

Dekai Hachi centers on a the titular character, a 40cm tall creature and his daily life alongside humans. Miseban no Spis centers on a mysterious fish that suddenly appears one day. Aa, Tanuki wa Mou Dame desu centers on a tanuki that is rented by various people.

(Source: ANN, edited)
